# Sri Sai Ram Ambulance Services

## Overview
Sri Sai Ram Ambulance Services (SSR) is a 24/7 ambulance service based in Dabagardens, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. The business provides emergency and planned patient transport, ICU ambulance support, ventilator support, and freezer box services.

## Contact
- Call: +91 91772 71425
- WhatsApp: +91 85006 36621
- Address: D.No 29-44-29/1, SBI Colony, CMR Back Side, Dabagardens Maharani Peta, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh 530020
- Service hours: Open 24 hours, 365 days

## Service focus
- A/C ICU ambulance services
- Ventilator support during transport
- Freezer box and dignified deceased transport
- Emergency response within roughly 60 km of Visakhapatnam
- Advance booking for long-distance patient transport across India
